svg.aria-label: Keycloak Event Listener for RabbitMQ — Java · Keycloak. Maintained by Mizzle Studio. Keycloak’s events arrive in the RabbitMQ queue keycloak-events: a LOGIN, then a USER CREATE by an administrator, land on top of REGISTER, LOGIN_ERROR and LOGOUT, and its count of ready messages goes from 3 to 5.
